transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. We've got the batch of 2,400 zinc-coated fasteners on quality hold due to that curing oven temperature alarm during the run. Before I can make the disposition decision and close this out, we need to go through our standard fact-recording routine. I'd like to hear from each of you in turn: process, laboratory, logistics, and customer-compliance. Please give one concise verbal update so I can record it. Who'd like to start with the process update?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I've reviewed the oven recorder and tray map after the alarm. Exactly 700 fasteners from trays P17 through P23 were outside the approved cure profile; the other 1,700 were within profile. The 700 affected fasteners can be re-cured in Oven 2 for exactly 2 hours. I have not yet attached the review to the batch record.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: My coating evaluation found that any re-cured fasteners require salt-spray confirmation using exactly 20 sample pieces before release. This requirement was issued by the laboratory method review this afternoon, but it is not yet on the hold checklist.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: For my logistics update: I've physically verified that pallets P17 through P23 are isolated in the marked quarantine lane, and pallets P1 through P16 contain the unaffected fasteners. However, I have not yet entered the pallet-location verification in the warehouse system.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: Thank you, Caleb. For my customer-compliance update: I checked the customer's quality portal and confirmed that any re-cured fasteners require a customer concession and a Certificate of Conformance identifying the re-cure. I have not yet added the portal confirmation to the customer file, but I wanted to make sure this requirement is on record before you make the disposition decision, Mara.
transcript.speaker: A5

commitments.detail: Attach the oven recorder and tray map review to the batch record.
Add the salt-spray confirmation requirement (20 sample pieces) to the hold checklist.
Enter the pallet-location verification in the warehouse system.
Add the customer portal confirmation to the customer file.
